title: Tiger Population Increases in Sundarbans
content: The Royal Bengal Tiger population in the Sundarbans National Park has shown a positive increase according to the latest wildlife census. Forest officials credit strict anti-poaching measures, improved monitoring systems, and habitat protection efforts for this success. Community awareness programs have also helped reduce human–wildlife conflict. This growth highlights the importance of continued conservation and responsible wildlife management in one of the world’s most unique mangrove ecosystems.
